title: Pure D/D
summary: D/D and Dark Contract cards with generic staples. The page's combo lines add a Fiendsmith engine and Spright Elf, which is Forbidden, so they use cards this list leaves out. Zero Doom Queen Machinex and Dark Contract with the Zero King, both from 2025, turn the Contracts into summons; Gilgamesh sets the Pendulum Scales, and D/D/D Alfred the Divine Sage King, the newest Fusion, recycles materials from banishment. Zero King and Gilgamesh lock you into D/D monsters, so the Extra Deck is all D/D/D.
main: D/D/D Zero Doom Queen Machinex
Scale 0: the turn it's activated, places a Dark Contract from the Deck. Face-up in the Extra Deck, it comes back when a D/D/D or Dark Contract card is destroyed, then destroys a card.
D/D Savant Kepler
Scale 10. Summoned: searches a Dark Contract card or returns another D/D to the hand.
D/D Savant Copernicus
Scale 1. Summoned: sends a D/D or Dark Contract card from the Deck to the GY.
D/D Necro Slime
From the GY, Fusion Summons a D/D/D by banishing its materials from the GY.
D/D Swirl Slime
Fusion Summons a D/D/D from the hand; from the GY, summons a D/D from the hand.
D/D Count Surveyor
Discards another D/D to Special Summon itself; Scale 1.
D/D Defense Soldier
Summons a D/D from the Pendulum Zone; from the GY, adds a D/D Pendulum from the Extra Deck or GY.
D/D Lance Soldier
Tuner that raises a D/D's Level per Dark Contract; revives itself by destroying a Dark Contract.
D/D Scale Surveyor
Special Summons itself next to a D/D Pendulum and becomes Level 4; Scale 9.
D/D Extra Surveyor
Discards to add a face-up D/D Pendulum from the Extra Deck to the hand.
D/D Gryphon
Special Summons itself next to a D/D; Scale 1.
D/D Savant Thomas
Scale 6: adds a face-up D/D Pendulum from the Extra Deck; summons a Level 8 D/D/D from the Deck.
D/D/D Vice King Requiem
Scale 8: destroys Dark Contracts to summon itself from the Pendulum Zone at an adjusted Level.
Dark Contract with the Gate
Searches a D/D monster each turn, for 1000 LP each Standby Phase.
Dark Contract with the Zero King
2025 support. Destroys another D/D card to summon a D/D from the Deck.
Dark Contract with the Different Dimension
2025 support. Shuffles two Dark Contracts back to banish a card from the opponent's field or GY.
D/D/D Headhunt
With a D/D/D out, takes control of an opposing monster until your next turn's End Phase.
extra: D/D/D Alfred the Divine Sage King
Newest support. Fusion of two D/D: Fusion Summons a D/D/D by shuffling materials from the hand, field or banishment into the Deck; banished, puts Dark Contracts back on the field.
D/D/D Abyss King Gilgamesh
Link-2 for two D/D: places two D/D Pendulums from the Deck in the Scales.
D/D/D Wise King Solomon
Rank 4 for two D/D: detaches to search any D/D card.
D/D/D Sky King Zeus Ragnarok
Link-3: destroys a D/D or Dark Contract for an extra Pendulum Summon, and negates a hand trap.
D/D/D Flame King Genghis
Fusion of two D/D: revives a D/D whenever another D/D is summoned.
D/D/D First King Clovis
Level 6 Synchro: revives a banished D/D, or one from the GY if a Dark Contract is out.
D/D/D Cursed King Siegfried
Level 8 Synchro: negates a face-up Spell or Trap on either turn.
D/D/D Wave King Caesar
Rank 4 for two Fiends: revives the monsters destroyed this turn; sent to the GY, searches a Dark Contract.
D/D/D Wave High King Caesar
Rank 6: negates an effect that would Special Summon.
D/D/D Super Doom King Dark Armageddon
Rank 8 for two D/D/D: protects your Pendulums and destroys a monster per Pendulum you control.
D/D/D Deviser King Deus Machinex
Rank 10, also on top of a D/D/D: attaches an opposing monster that activates its effect.
D/D/D/D Dimensional King Arc Crisis
Fusion of four Fiends (Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, Pendulum): negates every opposing monster and attacks each one.
